dialogues.jp:
「そうだな……少し屋上にでも行って、気晴ら
　しでもして来よう」
dialogues.en: "I think I'll go to the rooftop and clear my mind......"
dialogues.text: "I think I'll go to the rooftop and clear my mind......"

dialogues.jp:
和久井の授業の後は、いつも｛・・・・・・／むちゃくちゃ｝かっ
たるい。
dialogues.en: I always feel exhausted after Wakui's class.
dialogues.text: I always feel exhausted after Wakui's class.

dialogues.jp:
「……せっかくだから、萌先輩に癒してもらう
　か」
dialogues.en: "......Hopefully Moe-sempai will make me feel relaxed."
dialogues.text: "......Hopefully Moe-sempai will make me feel relaxed."

dialogues.jp:
教員棟の屋上。普段は縁のない場所が、最近は
目的地になってしまっていた。
dialogues.en:
The rooftop of the teachers' building used to be an
unfamiliar place for me, but now it's my favorite place.
dialogues.text:
The rooftop of the teachers' building used to be an
unfamiliar place for me, but now it's my favorite place.

dialogues.jp: はたして、いた。
dialogues.en: Is she here...? Yes.
dialogues.text: Is she here...? Yes.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「あ、こんにちは、朝倉くん」
dialogues.en: "Oh, hello, Asakura-kun."
dialogues.text: "Oh, hello, Asakura-kun."

dialogues.jp:
萌先輩がニッコリと微笑み、快く迎え入れてく
れる。自然と、こちらも笑顔になる。
dialogues.en:
Moe-sempai softly smiled and welcomed me. I responded with a
smile, naturally.
dialogues.text:
Moe-sempai softly smiled and welcomed me. I responded with a
smile, naturally.

dialogues.jp: 「こんにちは」
dialogues.en: "Hello."
dialogues.text: "Hello."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「丁度よかったです。いま準備ができたところ
　なんですよ」
dialogues.en:
"You came at the right time. We just finished setting things
up."
dialogues.text:
"You came at the right time. We just finished setting things
up."

dialogues.jp: 萌先輩が、俺のために箸と皿を用意してくれる。
dialogues.en: Moe-sempai passed me a bowl and chopsticks.
dialogues.text: Moe-sempai passed me a bowl and chopsticks.

dialogues.jp:
「いや、今日はちょっと気分転換に来ただけだ
　から。それにしょっちゅう、ただ飯食らって
　たら悪いし」
dialogues.en:
"Well, I just came here to take a break. I feel bad getting
free food from you all the time."
dialogues.text:
"Well, I just came here to take a break. I feel bad getting
free food from you all the time."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「へぇ……意外と良心的じゃん」
dialogues.en: "Hmm...... You're more conscientious than I thought."
dialogues.text: "Hmm...... You're more conscientious than I thought."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「マジで感心されると複雑な気分だが……いっ
　たい、おまえはどんな評価を俺に下していた
　んだ」
dialogues.en:
"I feel uncomfortable getting a compliment from you......
but what kind of person did you think I was?"
dialogues.text:
"I feel uncomfortable getting a compliment from you......
but what kind of person did you think I was?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「そんなの気にしないでください。全然、平気
　ですから」
dialogues.en: "You don't have to feel bad. We don't mind at all."
dialogues.text: "You don't have to feel bad. We don't mind at all."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「それに、来て頂けるほうが嬉しいですから」
dialogues.en: "Plus, we're glad that you're here."
dialogues.text: "Plus, we're glad that you're here."

dialogues.jp: そこまで言われると、なんだか照れくさい。
dialogues.en: I felt shy hearing her words.
dialogues.text: I felt shy hearing her words.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「ま、あたしはお姉ちゃんがいいなら、別にい
　いけどね」
dialogues.en: "Well, I don't care as long as my sister's fine with it."
dialogues.text: "Well, I don't care as long as my sister's fine with it."

dialogues.jp: 萌先輩だけでなく、眞子までも普通に微笑む。
dialogues.en: Mako also smiled at me.
dialogues.text: Mako also smiled at me.

dialogues.jp: 「そういうことなら、ありがたく頂きます」
dialogues.en: "Well, thank you very much."
dialogues.text: "Well, thank you very much."

dialogues.jp: 差し出されたものを受け取ると、席に着く。
dialogues.en: I accepted their offer and sat down by the table.
dialogues.text: I accepted their offer and sat down by the table.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「ま、いずれ借りは返してもらうけど」
dialogues.en: "You need to pay us back someday, though."
dialogues.text: "You need to pay us back someday, though."

dialogues.jp:
冗談っぽく、一言、付け加えてくるあたりは、
やはり眞子だ。
dialogues.en: Mako added jokingly. That's her personality.
dialogues.text: Mako added jokingly. That's her personality.

dialogues.jp: 「これは、なんですか？」
dialogues.en: "What's this?"
dialogues.text: "What's this?"

dialogues.jp: 鍋の具が、少し変わっているような気がする。
dialogues.en: The ingredients in the hot pot looked different today.
dialogues.text: The ingredients in the hot pot looked different today.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「だまっこ汁です」
dialogues.en: "This is called Damakko soup."
dialogues.text: "This is called Damakko soup."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「だまっこ……汁？」
dialogues.en: "Damakko...... soup?"
dialogues.text: "Damakko...... soup?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Yes."
dialogues.text: "Yes."

dialogues.jp:
萌先輩はニッコリと頷くが、俺はまったく聞い
たことがない名前だ。
dialogues.en:
Moe-sempai smiled at me, but I've never heard of such a
soup.
dialogues.text:
Moe-sempai smiled at me, but I've never heard of such a
soup.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「秋田の郷土料理なんですよ」
dialogues.en: "It's a local dish from Akita."
dialogues.text: "It's a local dish from Akita."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「この丸っこいのは、なんですか？」
dialogues.en: "What are these round things?"
dialogues.text: "What are these round things?"

dialogues.jp:
白い団子みたいなのを箸でつつきながら、萌先
輩に尋ねる。
dialogues.en:
I asked Moe-sempai, poking at the white round thing with my
chopsticks.
dialogues.text:
I asked Moe-sempai, poking at the white round thing with my
chopsticks.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「それが『だまっこ』っていうんですよ。ご飯
　を｛・・・／半殺し｝にして、お団子にしたものなんです」
dialogues.en: "That's called Damakko. It's made of half killed rice."
dialogues.text: "That's called Damakko. It's made of half killed rice."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「半殺し？」
dialogues.en: "Half-killed?"
dialogues.text: "Half-killed?"

dialogues.jp:
萌先輩に似つかわしくない言葉に、思わず同じ
言葉を繰り返す。
dialogues.en:
I repeated her as I heard unfitting words coming out of her
mouth.
dialogues.text:
I repeated her as I heard unfitting words coming out of her
mouth.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「はい。全部つぶさないで、お米の粒が見える
　ぐらいにするんです」
dialogues.en:
"Yes. It means mashing the rice halfway, so you can still
see the grains."
dialogues.text:
"Yes. It means mashing the rice halfway, so you can still
see the grains."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「へえ……おはぎみたいなもんか。萌先輩って、
　鍋に詳しいんですね」
dialogues.en:
"Hmm...... That's interesting. You know a lot about hot pot,
huh?"
dialogues.text:
"Hmm...... That's interesting. You know a lot about hot pot,
huh?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Yes."
dialogues.text: "Yes."

dialogues.jp: なんだか、凄く意外な気がした。
dialogues.en: I was impressed.
dialogues.text: I was impressed.

dialogues.jp:
鍋に詳しいというのもだが、こんなに料理が上
手いとは……。
dialogues.en:
She's very knowledgeable about hot pot, and she really can
cook......
dialogues.text:
She's very knowledgeable about hot pot, and she really can
cook......

dialogues.jp:
なんだかもの凄くおっとりしてて、むっちゃド
ジっぽいんだけどな。
dialogues.en: Normally, she seems very quiet and absent minded.
dialogues.text: Normally, she seems very quiet and absent minded.

dialogues.jp: ――いや、実際そうなんだけど。
dialogues.en: Indeed, that's how she really is.
dialogues.text: Indeed, that's how she really is.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「それにしても、鍋って色んな種類があるよね」
dialogues.en: "There are many kinds of different hot pot."
dialogues.text: "There are many kinds of different hot pot."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「まあ、それだけ日本人が鍋が好きだってこと
　だろう」
dialogues.en: "It show how much the Japanese people love hot pot."
dialogues.text: "It show how much the Japanese people love hot pot."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「そうですね。でも、鍋が普及したのは、江戸
　時代だそうですよ」
dialogues.en:
"You're right. However, hot pot only became popular in the
Edo period."
dialogues.text:
"You're right. However, hot pot only became popular in the
Edo period."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「へぇ……そんなに大昔から、あるわけじゃな
　かったんだ」
dialogues.en: "Hmm...... So the history isn't that old, huh?"
dialogues.text: "Hmm...... So the history isn't that old, huh?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「でも、当時は下等な食べ物として見られてい
　たそうです」
dialogues.en:
"However, hot pot was looked at as a poor people's food at
the time."
dialogues.text:
"However, hot pot was looked at as a poor people's food at
the time."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「え、どうして？」
dialogues.en: "Why's that?"
dialogues.text: "Why's that?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「日本料理の“一人一膳”の作法に、反します
　から」
dialogues.en:
"It doesn't correspond with the Japanese custom of 'One tray
per person'."
dialogues.text:
"It doesn't correspond with the Japanese custom of 'One tray
per person'."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「あぁ、でも、そんな理由で下等ってもなぁ」
dialogues.en: "So that's why they looked at it as a poor people's food?"
dialogues.text: "So that's why they looked at it as a poor people's food?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「ただ……もともと囲炉裏を囲む生活をしてい
　た地方の庶民の方たちは、普通に食べていた
　んだそうです」
dialogues.en:
"But people in the countryside ate it regularly, sitting
around the hearth."
dialogues.text:
"But people in the countryside ate it regularly, sitting
around the hearth."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「はぁ」

なんだか、だんだんと『鍋の歴史』の授業になっ
てきた感じがするような……。
dialogues.en:
I was starting to feel like I'm taking a 'History of hot
pot' class.
dialogues.text:
I was starting to feel like I'm taking a 'History of hot
pot' class.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「ですから、鍋が正式に『料理』として認めら
　れるようになったのは、明治時代になってか
　らなんです」
dialogues.en:
"Therefore, hot pot was finally recognized as a 'dish' in
the Meiji period."
dialogues.text:
"Therefore, hot pot was finally recognized as a 'dish' in
the Meiji period."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「それに、一般のお家に普及したのは、戦後に
　なって、生活スタイルが変化してからなんで
　すよ」
dialogues.en:
"Also, it didn't spread into mainstream families until
people's lifestyles changed after the war."
dialogues.text:
"Also, it didn't spread into mainstream families until
people's lifestyles changed after the war."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「それにですね……」

とても楽しそうに話す萌先輩。なんだか延々と
続きそうな予感……。
dialogues.en:
Moe-sempai continued to speak joyfully. I suspect her
lecture will never end......
dialogues.text:
Moe-sempai continued to speak joyfully. I suspect her
lecture will never end......

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉……責任とりなさいよね」
dialogues.en: "Asakura...... You're responsible for this."
dialogues.text: "Asakura...... You're responsible for this."

dialogues.jp:
｛にら／睨｝みつける眞子と楽しげに話す萌先輩に挟まれ
ながら、俺はここでも、鐘が鳴るのを待つしか
なかった……。
dialogues.en:
As Mako stared at me with a dirty look, and Moe-sempai
continued talking joyfully, I could only wait for the bell
to ring......
dialogues.text:
As Mako stared at me with a dirty look, and Moe-sempai
continued talking joyfully, I could only wait for the bell
to ring......

dialogues.jp: 屋上の風は今日も冷たい。
dialogues.en: The wind's cold again, here on the rooftop.
dialogues.text: The wind's cold again, here on the rooftop.

dialogues.jp: ◆授業科目はお鍋◆
dialogues.en: ◆The hot pot class◆
dialogues.text: ◆The hot pot class◆

dialogues.jp:
永遠に続くかと思われた和久井の授業を終え、
気晴らしにやってきた屋上で萌先輩に鍋をご馳
走になる。
dialogues.en:
After Wakui's never ending class, I went to the rooftop to
eat hot pot and relax with Moe-sempai.
dialogues.text:
After Wakui's never ending class, I went to the rooftop to
eat hot pot and relax with Moe-sempai.

dialogues.jp:
――ハズだったのだが、今度は萌先輩の鍋につ
いての講義が始まってしまう。
dialogues.en:
......However, Moe-sempai started to lecture us about the
history of hot pot.
dialogues.text:
......However, Moe-sempai started to lecture us about the
history of hot pot.

dialogues.jp: 屋上の風は今日も冷たい。
dialogues.en: The wind was cold again, there on the rooftop.
dialogues.text: The wind was cold again, there on the rooftop.
